items.problem: Manifest migration guidance is not retrievable via the documented anchor mechanism; the agent burned 3 turns guessing 'manifest'/'manifest-migration-checklist' anchors that don't exist, then fell back to grepping headings.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 1662-1702 (turns 14-16): two 'Anchor ... not found' errors then a '^##' grep. Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 resolves only <a id> tags (script lines 42-55). Manifest content sits under <a id="csproj"> with no anchor of its own; SKILL.md line 158 links a non-fetchable slug.
items.root_cause: Package.appxmanifest reconciliation — a mandatory step in every migration — had no retrievable <a id> anchor and was only reachable by fetching the unrelated 'csproj' anchor or reading the whole file.
items.change: Added <a id="manifest"> before the 'Package.appxmanifest — reconcile...' heading in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md so `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest` returns the manifest guidance; added <a id="wui-warnings"> before the 'WUI analyzer warnings' heading to keep the manifest fetch tightly scoped and make the universal WUI-residue section independently fetchable.
items.expected_effect: A future agent that reaches for the manifest step retrieves it in one call instead of guessing anchors and grepping.
items.falsifiable_check: `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest` exits 0 and returns the two manifest subsections (verified); re-run migration logs show no 'Anchor ... not found' errors for the manifest step.

items.problem: SKILL.md pointed at the manifest guidance via a rendered markdown slug the retrieval script cannot resolve, and its project-file step fetched only the csproj anchor, so the agent had no correct path to the manifest anchor.
items.evidence: SKILL.md Step 2 (only fetched -Anchor csproj) and Step 4 item 5 cross-link '#manifest-migration-checklist-windowsdesktop--runfulltrust' (line 158).
items.root_cause: The skill referenced manifest work but never surfaced a fetchable anchor for it.
items.change: Step 2 now also instructs `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest`; Step 4 item 5 cross-link retargeted to the fetchable `#manifest` anchor.
items.expected_effect: The documented references now match the retrieval mechanism, so copying them into Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 succeeds.
items.falsifiable_check: The anchor referenced in SKILL.md (`manifest`) resolves via Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 with exit 0 (verified).

deferred_to_human: Headless-environment WinUI 3 screenshot capture is blank (CopyFromScreen/DirectComposition GDI-capture limitation). This is a scoring/eval-harness concern, not a migration-skill defect — out of scope for the migration skillset.
